items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. This zero-day flaw has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. This vulnerability has been added to CISA's KEV catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension for Magento allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw was found in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento full-page cache extension, which could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
